name: Prompt Runner
oneLine: A browser extension with a RAG knowledge base, long-term memory and a tool-using agent.
problem: Prompts used in the browser are re-typed and have no memory of earlier work or reference material.
built: A Manifest V3 browser extension, loaded unpacked, with a retrieval knowledge base, long-term memory and an agent that can call tools.
decisions: Retrieval, memory and tool use are separate parts of the extension.
